gemini.performance_metric: $185 million non-cash goodwill charge specific to the acquired electric utility
gemini.rationale: The slice documents the divestiture of the pipeline-construction subsidiary and a $185 million goodwill charge on the electric utility, but does not attribute these to product/process incoherence (p4). It also notes $102 million in severance costs immediately after closing, but provides no evidence of ongoing process/organization fracture over time (p5).

grok.performance_metric: IS divested ~$850M/~14mo; $185M Indiana Electric GW charge; utilities retained through FY2022
grok.rationale: No product/process-interface disruption is documented: the $185M Indiana Electric goodwill charge is attributed to pandemic-related market-cap decline, not product-line/operations incoherence, and Indiana Gas/SIGECO/VEDO continued as reported operating regulated-utility segments through the FY2022 10-K. No process/organization fracture is documented either; 2019 integration costs ($83M) and merger-related severance ($102M) are recorded as one-time closing-period items, with the acquired utilities remaining in the Electric and Natural Gas segments and no cultural or operations-vs-organization break described over the horizon.
